item.text: The revised strategy averages 42.97 waves on five seeds I held out from layout tuning. It uses cannon splash against ground clusters, adds flak as air pressure builds, and prioritizes menders and enemies close to leaking. I’m now checking the replay and controls.

item.text:
Created [index.html](/private/tmp/pcd-sbx-codex-gpt-6.2-sol-low-r2-qfz0lmz7/work/index.html), the only file in the workspace. It includes the 100-second deterministic 3D replay, five-state playback controls, WebGL HUD, combat and collapse effects, and synthesized audio.

Both simulator self-checks matched (`82a5353d` and `2e8858d7`). The simulator uses the 28-tile air route implied by the waypoints. The stated 26-tile length failed both checks.

The strategy averaged **42.97 waves** across five held-out seeds. It clusters cannons around ground turns, adds flak in response to air pressure, and prioritizes splash damage, menders, and imminent leaks. Seed `42` scored **42.13 waves**, with the keep falling at tick `1705`.

I opened the file directly in Firefox at `1280×650` and verified the countdown, silent Re-fire hold, pixel-identical reverse scrubbing, and endpoint restart. The replay uses procedural geometry and particles for combat effects. I did not measure frame rate or listen to the audio mix.
